decisions.reason: The interboard interface already carries 5V from the power board; selecting the LED level-shifter part does not change its connectors, pinout, or power-distribution role.
The standalone USB supply already excludes the LEDs from its 3.3V powered rail, so confirming 5V LED operation does not change this Requirement.
The source does not change the daughterboard's LED count, board form, addressable behavior, or selected LED part; power and data-level conditioning are owned by the source Requirement.
The DCDC1 Requirement already defines a 3.3V rail for its listed loads and does not include the addressable LEDs; the source does not alter its voltage, rating, or role.
Charge status remains displayed through the SK6812 chain on GPIO13, and the source changes only the chain's electrical power and data-level interface.
The source concerns the SK6812 electrical interface and does not change the SPS30 connector, 5V supply, I2C signals, or SEL connection.
The switchable 5V rail already includes the SK6812 LEDs as powered loads; replacing the data-line level shifter does not change rail enable control, loads, or standby policy.
The monitored rails remain 3.3V and 5V, and the LED level-shifter substitution does not change the current-monitor device, channel allocation, or measurement coverage.

This Requirement is specifically scoped to power-board BOM readiness, while the source replaces the addressable-LED data-line level shifter and does not establish a change to the tracked power-board BOM attributes.
The source does not alter any sensor-board input connector, module connector, signal assignment, or connector count.
The LED supply and level-shifter decision does not change the power board's dimensions, orientation, mounting, or connector-clearance constraints.
The source does not change battery protection circuitry, cutoff voltages, or DW01A protection components and functions.
